# Stable LogSumExp Implementations

The log-sum-exp function $\text{LSE}(x) = \log\sum_i e^{x_i}$ appears in softmax, cross-entropy, CRF inference, mixture models, variational bounds, and beam search. Its naive computation overflows and underflows. The max-shift trick is universally applicable.

## The LogSumExp Function

$$\text{LSE}(x) = \log\sum_{i=1}^n e^{x_i}$$

Key properties:
- $\text{LSE}(x) \geq \max(x)$ — smooth upper bound on the max
- $\nabla \text{LSE}(x) = \text{softmax}(x)$ — gradient is the softmax vector
- Convex in $x$
- LSE$(x/T)\cdot T \to \max(x)$ as $T \to 0$ — temperature annealing

## Stable Computation

$$\text{LSE}(x) = m + \log\sum_i e^{x_i - m}, \quad m = \max(x)$$

After shifting: max term $= e^0 = 1$ (no overflow), all others $\leq 1$ (no overflow), sum $\geq 1$ (no log(0)).

```python
import torch, torch.nn.functional as F, numpy as np

# Always use the built-in
x = torch.tensor([1000., 1001., 1002.])
print(torch.logsumexp(x, dim=0))   # 1002.4076  (correct)

# Batch LSE
batch = torch.randn(32, 10)
lse   = torch.logsumexp(batch, dim=1)  # [32]

# Mixture model log-likelihood
def mixture_log_likelihood(log_pi, log_component_densities):
    """log p(x) = logsumexp_k(log pi_k + log p_k(x))"""
    return torch.logsumexp(log_component_densities + log_pi, dim=1)  # [N]

# CRF forward algorithm (log-domain)
def crf_log_partition(emissions, transitions):
    """O(T * K^2) via dynamic programming in log-domain."""
    T, K = emissions.shape
    alpha = emissions[0]
    for t in range(1, T):
        alpha = torch.logsumexp(
            alpha.unsqueeze(1) + transitions, dim=0) + emissions[t]
    return torch.logsumexp(alpha, dim=0)   # log Z

# Importance-Weighted ELBO
def iwelbo(log_w):
    """log_w: [K, B] log importance weights. Returns [B] ELBO estimates."""
    K = log_w.shape[0]
    return torch.logsumexp(log_w, dim=0) - np.log(K)
```

## CRF Log-Partition Function

$$\alpha_t(j) = \text{logsumexp}_{i}\!\left[\alpha_{t-1}(i) + \log A_{ij}\right] + \log\phi_t(j)$$

$$\log Z = \text{logsumexp}_j\,\alpha_T(j)$$

All operations in log-domain. Avoids underflow in sequences where product of probabilities is $\sim 10^{-100T}$.

## Beam Search Score Normalisation

$$\log p(y_1,\ldots,y_t|x) = \sum_{s=1}^t \log p(y_s|y_1,\ldots,y_{s-1},x)$$

Sum of log-probabilities replaces product of probabilities — no underflow for any sequence length. Length-normalise via dividing by $t^\alpha$ or a logsumexp-based penalty.

## Importance Weighted ELBO

$$\text{IWELBO}_K = \mathbb{E}\!\left[\log\frac{1}{K}\sum_k w_k\right] = \mathbb{E}\!\left[\text{logsumexp}_k(\log w_k) - \log K\right]$$

As $K\to\infty$: IWELBO$_K \to \log p(x)$ (exact marginal likelihood).

| Application | LSE Structure | Stable Formula |
|---|---|---|
| Softmax | $e^{x_i}/\sum e^{x_j}$ | $e^{x-m}/\sum e^{x-m}$ |
| Cross-entropy NLL | $\text{LSE}(x) - x_{\text{target}}$ | $m + \log\sum e^{x-m} - x_t$ |
| CRF partition | $\sum_y e^{\text{score}(y,x)}$ | Forward algo in log-domain |
| Mixture $\log p$ | $\log\sum_k \pi_k p_k(x)$ | $\text{logsumexp}_k(\log\pi_k + \log p_k)$ |
| IWELBO | $\log\tfrac{1}{K}\sum_k w_k$ | $\text{logsumexp}_k(\log w_k) - \log K$ |
| Beam search | $\prod p(y_t\|y_{<t})$ | $\sum \log p(y_t\|y_{<t})$ |

> **TIP: torch.logsumexp Is Your Friend**
> `torch.logsumexp(x, dim)` applies the max-shift trick internally, is differentiable (gradient is softmax), and works on any batch dimension. Never implement LSE from scratch in production. Two operations cover all probability-domain arithmetic: add log-probs (= multiply probs); `logsumexp` (= marginalise/sum probs).

> **INFO: LogSumExp as a Smooth Maximum**
> $\text{LSE}(x/T)\cdot T \to \max(x)$ as $T\to0$. Useful as a differentiable maximum in softmax attention, smooth hinge loss approximations, and temperature annealing toward greedy argmax.
